import pathlib, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import drive_cli_rules as R
mr = pathlib.Path("docs/missions/MODEL_ROUTING.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
note = "Interactive CLIs driven by scripts/drive-cli.sh stop with exit 3 on any prompt after an answered trust prompt and on numbered or menu approval prompts; boxed menus and alternate-screen redraws are accepted residuals that end as an exit-4 stall, and no wrong answer is ever sent."
assert note in mr.splitlines(), "missing F011 routing note"
rules = R.load_rules()
ws = "/tmp/ws"
answered = "Do you trust the files in this folder?\n/tmp/ws\n[y/n] "
stop = ("stop", 3, None)
def t(d):
    return (d["decision"], d["exit_code"], d["answer"])
assert t(R.match_pane(answered, ws, rules)) == ("answer", None, "y\n")
later = ("Unknown prompt? [y/n]", "Overwrite config.json? [y/n]", "Apply patch to src/app.py? [y/n]", "Enable telemetry uploads? (y/n)", "Continue? yes/no", "Press enter to continue", "Do you trust the files in this folder?\n/tmp/ws/other\n[y/n]", "Do you trust this folder /tmp/ws [y/n]", "Do you trust the files in this folder?\n/tmp/ws\n[y/n]", "Allow git push origin main? [y/n]")
for p in later:
    for cur in (answered + "y\n" + p, answered + "\n" + p):
        got = R.classify_window(cur, ws, answered, rules)
        assert t(got) == stop and got["category"] in ("unknown_prompt", "never"), (p, cur, got)
assert t(R.classify_window(answered + "y\ntrusted and done", ws, answered, rules)) == ("wait", None, None)
menus = ("Do you want to proceed?\n\u276f 1. Yes\n  2. No", "Choose:\n[1] Yes\n[2] No", "Overwrite config.json? y/N", "1. Yes", "[1] Yes", "\u276f 1.", "Select an option [1-3]:", "  1. Yes\n\u276f 2. Yes, and do not ask again\n  3. No")
for p in menus:
    for got in (R.match_pane(p, ws, rules), R.classify_window(answered + "y\n" + p, ws, answered, rules)):
        assert (got["decision"], got["category"], got["rule_id"], got["answer"], got["exit_code"]) == ("stop", "unknown_prompt", None, None, 3), (p, got)
boxed = "\u256d" + "\u2500" * 24 + "\u256e\n\u2502 Do you want to proceed?\u2502\n\u2502 \u276f 1. Yes               \u2502\n\u2502   2. No                \u2502\n\u2570" + "\u2500" * 24 + "\u256f"
residuals = (R.match_pane(boxed, ws, rules), R.classify_window(answered + "y\n" + boxed, ws, answered, rules), R.classify_window("Overwrite config.json\n[y/n] ", ws, answered, rules), R.classify_window("Do you trust the files in this folder?\n/tmp/ws/other\n[y/n] ", ws, answered, rules), R.classify_window(answered, ws, answered, rules))
for got in residuals:
    assert got["decision"] != "answer" and got["answer"] is None, got
print("ok")
